summary: Gives each createSession its own plugin instances, releases the manifest lock during driver/plugin scripts, removes a session before its driver finishes deletion, and bounds BiDi subscription state.

Removes --callback-address/-port, --debug-log-spacing, --strict-caps and --trace-dir; rejects non-object POST bodies; case-sensitive caps; Windows driver replaced by WinCore; JSONWP internals dropped.
Fixes the execute-driver plugin wrapping non-configurable property descriptors through a shadow target.
